parameters.query:
SELECT cp.bot_id, cp.user_id, cp.user_id AS chat_id, c.bot_token, COALESCE(NULLIF(cp.display_name,''),'') AS name, COALESCE(NULLIF(cp.language,''),'Russian') AS language
FROM client_profile cp JOIN clients c ON c.bot_id=cp.bot_id
WHERE cp.proactive_enabled = true AND cp.onboarding_done = true AND c.bot_type IN ('client','trusted')
 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM proactive_log pl WHERE pl.bot_id=cp.bot_id AND pl.user_id=cp.user_id AND pl.kind='silence' AND pl.sent_at >= now()-interval '14 days')
 AND (SELECT max(h.created_at) FROM n8n_chat_histories h WHERE h.session_id = cp.bot_id||':'||cp.user_id) < now()-interval '5 days'
 AND (SELECT max(h.created_at) FROM n8n_chat_histories h WHERE h.session_id = cp.bot_id||':'||cp.user_id) >= now()-interval '30 days';
INSERT INTO proactive_log (bot_id, user_id, kind) VALUES ($1, $2, 'silence');
